text: athena plan (from 20261016-060424-614b) reads unread requests to fill their plans, but reading moves a request from queued to proposed, and plan and drain only look at queued ones: after one 'athena plan --budget 15' all 25 open requests became proposed, plan says nothing is open, and drain has nothing to work. Also at the default --budget 2 it read none ('no room in the job limit or the budget'). Read requests must stay in the plan and the drain's queue.
